identityAudit.canonicalDescription: Rhea, capopalestra Acciaio di Ferraluce; grembiule d’officina corto e guanto magnetico
identityAudit.visibleAtlasDetails: Copper/auburn hair gathered back; round workshop goggles worn atop the head; navy short-sleeve workwear; cream bib apron with brown straps; brown utility belt and pouches; navy work trousers with lighter reinforced panels; dark/navy boots with light toe/side accents; one large two-disc magnetic gauntlet worn on anatomical RIGHT forearm/hand (viewer-left in front), with an ordinary dark work glove on anatomical LEFT hand. The atlas also shows a handheld wrench; omitted in idle. Gender and age are not stated and are not inferred.

styleReferenceConstraint: ImageGen takes the identity atlas plus four style-only images per generation. The first three directions used Nilo, Mira, Dalia, and Aster; the final north variant used Elia, Nilo, Mira, and Dalia. Across the chosen candidates, all five named style references are represented. No style reference contributes identity or outfit details.

candidates.prompt: Create one transparent full-body SOUTH/front idle character PNG, portrait 2:3. Images 2-5 are only references for the series' painterly modern 2D RPG rendering style. Do not copy their subjects or accessories. Match the atlas closely and keep the clothing simple. Rhea has the same apparent face, copper/auburn hair tied back, and one pair of workshop goggles worn on top of the head. Outfit is the pictured dark navy short-sleeved workshop coveralls, a modest cream bib apron with brown leather straps and hem, a brown work belt with the same few small pouches/hardware visible in the atlas, navy work trousers with the same restrained lighter knee panels, and simple dark navy work boots with the atlas's light toe/side accents. Do not redesign the silhouette or add fashion details. Exactly ONE heavy magnetic gauntlet is worn on Rhea's ANATOMICAL RIGHT forearm and hand (viewer-LEFT when facing front). Keep only the integrated round metal mechanisms that are part of this gauntlet. The ANATOMICAL LEFT arm has only the simple dark work glove shown in the atlas; no gauntlet there. The round workshop goggles stay on the head, not held. The wrench visible in the source is held equipment: omit it. Both arms hang naturally relaxed at the sides; both hands are empty, no hand on hip and no hand in pockets. IMPORTANT: The boots have NO circular mechanism, disc, dial, badge, medallion or extra hardware; never copy the wrist gauntlet onto the footwear. Avoid adding extra straps, clips, rings, knee guards, tools, pouches, logos or other details beyond those clearly present in the atlas. One centered figure, hair and soles visible with margin, actual transparent alpha. No background, floor, shadow, glow, halo, vignette, text, extra characters, bags, props, mirrored outfit, 3D or photorealism.

notes: All four candidate PNGs are direct raw copies of ImageGen outputs, with no resizing, crop, flip, alpha cleanup or pixel edits. Candidates remain private under .tmp; no runtime, catalog, registry, map or test files modified.

calibration.originX: alpha-weighted centroid of alpha>=128 pixels in the bottom 50px of the visible body bounding box, normalized by image width
calibration.originY: exclusive bottom of visible alpha>=128 body bounding box, normalized by image height
calibration.note: Source PNGs are preserved as generated; runtime WebP files decode to pixel-identical RGBA.
